text: Only firm people can be truly soft.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
visual_brief: An engineering line study of a tempered recurve bow limb shown under tension, depicting both its relaxed contour and flexed arc in precise technical lines, accompanied by subtle bending-moment curves and center-of-mass markers on a pure black field.
alt: Engineering line drawing of a flexed recurve bow limb under tension.
